offence_note: Assault, mischief over $5,000, intimidating justice system participant

offence_note: Possession for trafficking, possession of cocaine, concealed weapon

note: Illegal probation order set aside; jail term unchanged

offence_note: Historical indecent assault of a young boy

note: Two months dead time doubled to four months credit; 32 months remaining
